description: Major annual festival where thousands of devotees gather at Palampet to perform Abhishekam, Rudrabhishekam, and night-long Jagaran to Lord Ramalingeswara Swamy.
importance: The primary spiritual and religious festival of the year, drawing massive crowds for overnight prayers and grand temple rituals.

description: Cultural programmes and heritage events are occasionally organized by Telangana Tourism
importance: Celebrates the historical and architectural legacy of the UNESCO World Heritage site, promoting traditional arts and local tourism.

description: Special Pujas, Deepotsavam, and Abhishekam performed during the holy months of Shravanam and Kartheekam.
month: November / December (Kartheeka Masam) & July / August (Shravana Masam)
importance: Highly auspicious periods dedicated to Lord Shiva, marked by heavy pilgrim footfall, special lighting, and vibrant evening lamp rituals.
